method: Image generation, one asset per prompt, shared cemetery illustration as style reference
style: Crisp weathered painterly realism; silver-grey light; aged stone and wood; muted moss and earth; readable central landmark; no HUD, words, borders or plaques. Square focal composition usable in portrait card and landscape header.

scenes.scene: Quen stone with restrained yellow glow on the grassy woodland edge northeast of Cackler Bridge, ghoul nest earth nearby. Focus the single rune monolith among ferns.
Igni monolith with subtle orange glow before a small worn stone cemetery chapel, low gravestones and tangled tree branches. Rural, not cathedral.
Aard standing stone with restrained blue glow in northern White Orchard woods, pine trunks and a disturbed earthen ghoul nest nearby. Focus the stone, not a monster portrait.
Axii monolith with subtle green rune in an open lightly wooded field between the two tracks north of Sawmill. Suggest a thin wraith silhouette in distant mist, not a large foreground figure.
Quen monolith with restrained gold rune in a quiet little thicket above Broken Bridge; uneven uphill track, golden grass and close oaks. No guardian.
Yrden monolith with restrained purple rune east of the abandoned village, old roadside woods; a large brown bear watches from the middle distance. Stone remains focal.
Small deserter camp guarding a rustic bridge southwest of Crossroads. Low plank bridge, a tent, abandoned weapons and a chest at the southern end. Clear noon silhouettes; no combat gore.
Collapsed red-brick ramp climbing to a small ruined fort west of Ransacked Village. Tent and treasure chest on upper masonry, thin broken walls, wild grass. Central tower ruin, not a grand castle.
Deserter woodland clearing south of Ford: modest campfire, bow and steel weapons beside a rough tent, chest near fire and dense oaks. Warm fire versus cool shaded woods.

Dirty Funds camp northwest of Cackler Bridge: an unusually rich canvas leader tent, low table, several treasure chests, a shield propped against the tent pole, surrounding deserter camp in trees. No inscriptions or coins lettering.

Ghoul nest east of Crossroads: clearly visible earthen burrow, gnawed bones and scattered branches on a sloping grassy clearing, distant local track. Two small ghoul silhouettes in background, no hero.
Ghoul nest beside the Cackler Bridge stone: torn soil and a low burrow in a sunlit birch clearing; distant yellow-rune monolith subtly visible. Focal burrow and ragged grass.

Treasure pit below the cliffs south of Ransacked Village: two weathered chests in sandy shallow depression, river reeds, exposed bank and a ruined village silhouette high above. Waterline footprints; no gore.
Guarded treasure southeast of Woesong Bridge: broken river boat with a partly submerged chest and crate beside it; sun on water, mud and reeds. Wreck-and-chest focal, not an open sea ship.
Western garrison swamp treasure: solitary chest on a muddy little island, wisps of greenish marsh gas and distant ruined red brick fort. Poison gas subtly visible, not fantasy neon explosion.
Ruined wagon on the southeastern garrison approach, one chest still on cart and another beside it, wolves watching from reeds. Small White Orchard fort on far bank, not massive castle.

Dim crypt beneath the White Orchard cemetery chapel: brick vaults, roots, a chest and a weathered witcher relic beside an unreadable folded diagram. Single torch-gold light and spectral mist, no combat or readable text.

Temerian Valuables river trail: an old iron key and sealed soaked orders on a riverbank rock beside the bridge, submerged chest visible in clear shallows; Mill route in misty distance. No corpse close-up, no readable writing.

Deserter Gold spy camp: small isolated tent, travel pack and an unrolled unreadable spy note on a wooden chest in northern White Orchard woods. Neutral grey dawn, secretive atmosphere; no readable text.

Dirty Funds trailhead: a deserted woodland tent and chest holding an unreadable crumpled note, wolf tracks on damp earth, early sun through branches. This is the notes camp, not the larger final deserter tent.

Roadside shrine east of Abandoned Village restored after ghouls: small weathered wayside shrine and simple wooden shelter beside a dusty road, herbs and a villager’s basket, rural White Orchard trees and fields. No invented temple.
Abandoned Sawmill restored: weathered low timber sheds, stacked cut trunks, saw equipment, rough fences and a rural forest path. A small merchant stall implied, not a modern factory or watermill.

Yennefer’s crystal bird skull on grass beside the opening camp near Crossroads: a small translucent crystal raven-like skull, dew and ash from a cold campfire, ruined rural road in soft background. Precise small keepsake focal, not a giant monster skull.

Battlefield north of Ransacked Village: broken Temerian shields, discarded spears and trampled grass across a broad rural field, mist and distant ruined huts. Somber aftermath with no graphic wounds or bodies in close-up.
Weathered wooden fingerpost by the ruined Abandoned Village, old well and low burned timber cottages behind. Signboards have no readable text; clear road junction foreground.
Broken Bridge travel landmark: weathered fingerpost beside the damaged rural wooden crossing, missing planks, rocky slope and uphill track. No readable lettering.
Sawmill travel landmark: wooden fingerpost beside log stacks and weathered low sawmill sheds at woodland edge. No readable lettering.
Mill travel landmark: wooden fingerpost at a road with a rustic wooden windmill and low cottage nearby; pale White Orchard hills and hazy pines. No readable lettering.

Nilfgaardian Garrison travel landmark: wooden fingerpost below the small ruined red-brick river fortress; scaffolding and a modest military banner, rocky bank. No readable lettering or emblem invented as a logo.
Cackler Bridge landmark: wooden fingerpost by a rural gated wooden bridge, old palisade and spring woodland beyond. No readable lettering.

Crossroads landmark near the opening campsite: simple fingerpost where dusty tracks fork among grass and thin birches, extinguished campfire nearby, wide White Orchard countryside. No readable lettering.
Ford travel landmark: wooden fingerpost beside the shallow river crossing, cart tracks into water, reeds and distant cottages. No griffin battle; quiet useful landmark. No readable lettering.

Ransacked Village travel landmark: wooden fingerpost at a muddy fork, burned thatch roofs, leaning fences and one surviving hut. Bright overcast detail, not a fire disaster scene. No readable lettering.
Overview of White Orchard Places of Power: single aged rune monolith in countryside woods, faint ancient glow, low mist and distant chapel hint. Distinct balanced landscape, not multi-panel collage.
Overview of White Orchard bandit camps: rough canvas tents and a guarded treasure chest on ruined red brick beside forest road, spear and shield silhouettes. No portrait of generic bandit.
Overview of White Orchard monster nests: ragged earth burrow and roots among ferns, an unlit alchemical bomb and sword tip nearby, necrophage silhouettes distant. No giant boss monster.
Overview of guarded treasure: battered iron-banded chest at a river wreck, claw prints in mud, reeds, White Orchard woodland in silvery dawn. Chest as focal.

Create one sharp square overview of White Orchard hidden treasure hunts: battered chest at a low cellar entrance beside a humble timber cottage, old key and sealed unreadable orders in foreground, rustic wooden windmill with four large sails on a nearby hill. NO waterwheel, watermill or river at the mill. Match the cemetery illustration style master: crisp weathered painterly realism, aged wood and masonry, muted moss/earth, silver-grey dawn, amber cellar light. Center focal objects within the middle 55% for portrait and landscape crops. No people, legible text, numbers, HUD, logos, watermarks, borders or plaques.

Overview of restored abandoned sites: humble roadside shrine, a sawmill-like timber shelter and a returning villager’s supply basket in White Orchard countryside. One coherent location impression, not split panels.
Overview of other discoveries: a translucent crystal bird skull on an old Temerian shield at grassy camp edge, village path and distant battlefield under dawn mist. No readable text.
Overview of travel in White Orchard: rustic wooden fingerpost at a road junction, wooden bridge and distant windmill in rural valley. No readable sign lettering, no maps or labels.
Overview of equipment preparation: grindstone and armor workbench in a soot-stained village forge, steel tools and a warm hearth, dark timber and aged iron. Fine material detail.

Overview of White Orchard diagrams: steel and silver sword hilts beside unreadable hand-drawn crafting parchment in a ruined stone chamber, an old chest and cool light. No readable writing or inventory screen.
Northern cemetery woods ghoul nest: earthen burrow threaded with pale roots and bleached bones, pine needles and dark fir trunks; faint blue-rune stone through trees. Low-angle focus on nest mouth.

Bandit camp deep in the woods southwest of Broken Bridge. A low canvas tent protects a battered chest, archer equipment, damp tree trunks and a curved forest path. Distinct dusky charcoal-and-amber composition.
Camp northwest of Sawmill at the edge of the garrison marsh: ragged tent, chest and abandoned camp supplies between pines and reeds. Distinct foggy marsh rather than dry forest.

Smugglers cache at the river bridge south of Ford: low stone-and-timber crossing, partly submerged bundled goods and chest beneath it, clear river shallows, reeds and the southern country road. Focus hidden chest through water.

Sunken spoils east of Nilfgaardian Garrison: split-level view at river surface, weathered submerged barrel and bundled salvage underwater, the small broken red-brick garrison high on distant rocky bank. Clear water, subdued morning.

White Orchard village cow pasture near Woesong Bridge: rustic fence, two ordinary cattle, scattered hay, low timber-and-thatch village buildings. Looming shadow at the far woodland edge suggests caution without depicting an unverified monster attack.
Woesong Bridge travel landmark: wooden fingerpost at the village bridge, humble timber houses and river reflected behind it, pale spring light. No readable lettering.

Usable foot-powered grindstone outside Willis’s humble White Orchard village forge, anvil, bucket, soot-stained stone hearth and partly damaged roof behind. Focus the circular stone and crank; no people required.
Usable grindstone near the restored Sawmill: wooden treadle grinding wheel, rough log wall and stacked timber, mossy yard and cool woodland sun. Different from village forge; no masonry furnace.
Grindstone in the Nilfgaardian garrison service yard: foot-powered circular stone on wooden frame, red-brick ruined fort walls, a rack of unmarked swords and dark military canvas. Station is focal.

Armorer worktable near the Nilfgaardian Garrison: sturdy timber bench with tongs, small hammer, leather straps and one steel breastplate, ruined red-brick wall and military canvas behind. Focus bench, not a grindstone.
Overview of White Orchard water caches: clear river shallows with submerged chest and barrel, small wooden crossing and distant red-brick garrison; surface reflections, submerged salvage focal.
